title: BRING PLAYERS Skript good for PvP
features:
- bring players 
- good for PvP shooting/killing
- players kant see this but it still works
- tested in BIG Paintball 2 (OP)
-----------
HOW 2 USE:
- set distance to 1 if u want them to be on your player
- set TeamXhexk (TeamCheck) to 'false' to bring ALL players regardless of team, and set to 'true' if you only want enemies/players on the other team to be brought to you
